{{Quote|My mom on the other hand, most amazing woman I've ever known.|Landonis Balthazar Calrissian, to Han Solo|<ref name="Solo" />}}
A [[Gender|female]] individual was the '''mother''' of [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]]. Calrissian considered her to be the "most amazing woman" he had ever known.<ref name="Solo" /> Calrissian owned an [[aurodium]] ring with his [[Parent|mother's]] name inscribed in it.<ref name="TROSVD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Landonis Balthazar Calrissian's mother was first mentioned in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" />
